request: Build a small Jac web app for a whiteboard with rectangles, ellipses and arrows. Users select shapes by clicking or by dragging a selection box, move them, group and ungroup them, bring them to front, and undo or redo every action. Keep the board state and its history in a module that is tested without the UI.
acceptance: A selection box selects only shapes fully inside it.
Clicking any member of a group selects the whole group, and moving it moves every member by the same offset.
Undo after 'move then group' gives the moved but ungrouped state; any new action after an undo clears redo.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
